items.headline: Spider-Man swings to the second-biggest opening weekend ever
items.body: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' pulled in a jaw-dropping $355M in North America — landing within about $2M of Avengers: Endgame's all-time record. Tom Holland's back, and crowds handed it a rare A CinemaScore.
items.say: Did you catch Spider-Man this weekend? It basically broke the box office — second-biggest opening of all time.

items.headline: The Dodgers landed the best pitcher in baseball — Skubal's headed to LA
items.body: In the deadline's biggest bombshell, the two-time reigning champs traded for back-to-back Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal, sending three prospects to Detroit. An already-scary rotation just got scarier.
items.say: You see the Dodgers grabbed Skubal? The best pitcher in the game going to the two-time champs — kind of unfair, right?

items.headline: Messi's back on the field — and Suárez lit up a 2-2 thriller
items.body: Two weeks after the World Cup final, Lionel Messi came off the bench for Inter Miami as Luis Suárez rifled in a long-range stunner. A late Brais Méndez free kick rescued a 2-2 draw for Columbus.
items.say: Messi's finally back for Miami after the World Cup — Suárez scored an absolute rocket, but they only drew 2-2.

items.headline: SummerSlam's wild Night 1 — Oba Femi topples Brock Lesnar, Night 2 tonight
items.body: In a brutal Hell in a Cell, rising star Oba Femi beat Brock Lesnar in a genuine torch-passing moment, while CM Punk kept his title thanks to a shock Randy Orton return. The two-night event closes tonight.
items.say: Did you see SummerSlam? Oba Femi actually beat Brock Lesnar in Hell in a Cell — and there's a whole second night tonight.

items.headline: Counter-Strike crowns a champion today — Spirit vs. MOUZ in Malta
items.body: The BLAST Bounty Summer finals reach the trophy match at BLAST Arena in Malta, with world No. 3 Team Spirit facing MOUZ in a best-of-five. MOUZ swiped the opening map — it's playing out live.
items.say: The CS2 Bounty final is happening right now — Spirit vs MOUZ for the trophy in Malta. You watching any of it?

items.headline: A 30-second demolition — and the most finishes in UFC history
items.body: In the UFC's first-ever card in Serbia, hometown hero Uroš Medić flattened Daniel Rodriguez in just 30 seconds. The Belgrade crowd witnessed the most first-round finishes on a single card ever.
items.say: The UFC's Belgrade card was nuts — the main event ended in 30 seconds, and it set the record for most finishes ever.

items.headline: The last major of the year ends today — Yealimi Noh chasing a breakthrough
items.body: Noh takes a three-shot lead into Sunday's final round at Royal Lytham, hunting her first major title with Esther Henseleit in the final pairing. The seaside links are throwing everything at the field.
items.say: The Women's Open wraps up today — Yealimi Noh's up three going for her first major. Could be a big moment.

items.headline: Good news, everyone — Futurama returns tomorrow
items.body: Season 14 lands Monday on Hulu with two new episodes, promising swaggering space pirates, lab-grown meats, and the return of Dr. Zoidberg's long-lost love. Ten episodes are on the way.
items.say: Futurama's back tomorrow on Hulu with a new season — you ever watch it? 'Good news, everyone!'

items.headline: Lollapalooza closes out its biggest weekend — Tate McRae headlines the finale
items.body: The four-day Chicago blowout wraps tonight with Tate McRae and The xx up top, plus Turnstile, aespa and The Chainsmokers. Can't make it to Grant Park? It's streaming live on Hulu.
items.say: It's the last day of Lollapalooza — Tate McRae and The xx close it out tonight. You catch any of the streams?
